articles.title: Israel’s first ambassador to Somaliland presents credentials in Hargeisa
articles.description: Israel expands ties with the breakaway territory as Somalia challenges its motives and war intensifies in Yemen.

articles.title: Iran's top diplomat hopes US shows 'rationality,' and other Mideast news
articles.description: Iran's top diplomat hopes there is “rationality” on the U.S. side as diplomatic efforts aim to prevent a return to all-out war. Iranian officials have been in Qatar for talks on a proposal that would reopen the Strait of Hormuz if the U.S. meets several conditions. Meanwhile, Israeli strikes on Gaza killed eight people, including a young boy. The strikes occurred in Khan Younis and Gaza City. In Yemen, Iran-backed Houthi rebels blamed Saudi Arabia for airstrikes on a medical school. Qatar's national gas company reported one of its vessels was struck in the Persian Gulf.

articles.title: Israeli strike kills boy in Gaza as Qataris say vessel struck in Gulf, and other Mideast news
articles.description: Israeli strikes on Gaza have killed eight people including a young boy. The strikes happened on Sunday. Qatar’s national gas company reported a strike on one of its vessels in the Persian Gulf. The U.N. called for an investigation into the death of a staffer who was being held by Yemen’s Iran-backed Houthi rebels. Iran on Sunday designated Britain’s Royal Navy and Royal Air Force terrorist organizations and declared its MI6 foreign intelligence service a hostile entity. That's according to state-run IRNA news agency.
